findings.passage: More than 21.3 million Americans lack immediate access to documentary proof of citizenship. More than 140 million Americans do not have a passport. Elderly Americans are among the least likely to have one.
findings.note: Statement issued in his name as state party chairman on the day the Senate sent the SHIELD Act (citizenship checks of voters) to the Governor. He cites how many people lack documents proving citizenship. Date is from the Magnolia Tribune report that the release went out on that Tuesday.

findings.passage: There is no voter fraud crisis in Mississippi. There is a participation crisis, and instead of addressing it, they have made it worse.
findings.note: Same statement. He says voter fraud is not a problem in the state and that the SHIELD Act worsens low participation.
